description.value: Green Lake Station is a café and Chevron fuel stop on Crazy Canuck Drive near Green Lake in Whistler, open seven days a week. It serves an all-day breakfast kitchen, pizza, burgers, and paninis alongside BC-roasted drip coffee and espresso drinks, with a patio and a live-edge wooden communal table inside. The shop also stocks souvenirs and gifts, rounding out its appeal as a rest stop for anyone rolling through the area.
